entities.summary: The Nagore Dargah, also known as the Nagore Dargah Shareef, the Syed Shahul Hamid Dargah, or the Nagore Andavar Dargah, is a dargah complex built over the tomb of the Sufi saint Nagore Syed Abdul Qadir Shahul Hamid, located in Nagore, a coastal town in the Nagapattinam district of the state of Tamil Nadu, India.
